'''Adoris''' was a terrestrial astronomical object located in the [[Adoris system/Legends|Adoris system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Caltinia system/Legends|Caltinia]] and [[Knores system/Legends|Knores systems]]. It was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Tooka/Legends|tooka]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Feline/Legends|felines]]<ref name="TEA" /> also referred to as "Adoris Felines"<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{SWE|characters|tooka|tooka}}</ref> that were famous throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TEA" />

The native inhabitants of Adoris were known as [[Adorisian]]s and [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]] the tookas in a large number of varieties. Adoris was considered to be a possession of [[House Taneel]], one of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]] of the Senex-Juvex region that was based on the nearby [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Neelanon/Legends|Neelanon]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The name "Adoris" originated in [[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']], a [[1989]] [[West End Games]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' authored by [[Bill Slavicsek]], in reference to the Adoris Feline creature.<ref name="Otherspace">[[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']]</ref> "[[Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are]]," a [[1990]] roleplaying game source article published in the [[Voyages SF 13|thirteenth issue]] of the ''[[Voyages SF]]'' magazine placed the Adoris [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Adoris itself, in the [[Altor sector]].Since that article was released outside of the [[Lucas Licensing]] process,<ref name="Twinkle">{{VoyagesCite|13|Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star, How I Wonder Where We Are}}</ref> it was considered non-[[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="UnlicensedStatus">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> Drawing upon the original mention of the Adoris Feline, the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], established Adoris as an astronomical object and placed it in grid square L-17 as part of the Senex [[Sector/Legends|sector]], overriding the ''Voyages SF'' 13 placement.<ref name="TEA" />
